svg.text: Q and K build the scores. V skips ahead and gets weighted by them.
Multi-Head Attention: splitting d_model into heads
d_model = 64, h = 4 heads, head_dim = 16. Each color is one head. Diagonal label = sequence length S.
Gray cells on the S x S score matrix are future positions masked to -inf (decoder only). The encoder leaves every cell visible.
